import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Battery- and time-feasible reachable value after pickup, discounted by the time cost of the detour chain (pickup -> j -> charger), gated so only items that can actually be reached in time and battery contribute; charger gets 1-battery."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)
    is_item = values > 0
    arrival = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)
    norm = max(arrival.max(), 1e-9)
    b_after = battery - d * drain

    D = np.linalg.norm(targets[:, None, :] - targets[None, :, :], axis=2)
    dch = np.linalg.norm(targets - charger[None, :], axis=1)

    # battery feasibility: from candidate i we must reach j then return to charger
    reach = (b_after[:, None] - (D + dch[None, :]) * drain) > 0
    reach &= is_item[None, :]
    np.fill_diagonal(reach, False)

    # time feasibility: chain i->j->charger must fit in remaining horizon
    chain_time = d[:, None] + D + dch[None, :]
    reach &= chain_time <= time_left + 1e-9

    # decayed value of j at the moment we'd reach it via i
    vj = np.maximum(values[None, :] - rates[None, :] * (d[:, None] + D), 0.0)
    # discount by the time cost of the detour (later items decay more & waste horizon)
    time_disc = 1.0 / (1.0 + chain_time / max(time_left, 1e-3))
    contrib = np.where(reach, vj * time_disc, 0.0)
    look = contrib.sum(axis=1) / norm
    out = np.clip(look / 3.0, -1.0, 1.0)
    # charger candidate only meaningful when battery is low
    charger_score = (~is_item).astype(float) * (1.0 - battery)
    return np.where(is_item, out, charger_score)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Competition pressure: decayed arrival value of each candidate minus the best decayed arrival value among the other visible items it would displace, i.e. how much better this candidate is than the alternative you forgo; zero for the charger."""
    pos = np.asarray(pos, dtype=float)
    targets = np.asarray(targets, dtype=float)
    values = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    rates = np.asarray(rates, dtype=float)
    is_item = values > 0
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)
    arrival = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)
    # best arrival value among the *other* items
    masked = np.where(is_item, arrival, -1.0)
    k = targets.shape[0]
    if k > 1:
        # second-best when the candidate is the max, otherwise the max
        order = np.argsort(masked)
        best = masked[order[-1]]
        second = masked[order[-2]]
        best_other = np.where(masked >= best - 1e-12, second, best)
    else:
        best_other = np.zeros(k)
    best_other = np.maximum(best_other, 0.0)
    scale = max(float(arrival.max()), 1e-9)
    margin = (arrival - best_other) / scale
    out = np.where(is_item, np.clip(margin, -1.0, 1.0), 0.0)
    return np.nan_to_num(out, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Per-cycle arrival payoff (arrival value / cycle time) weighted by a Gaussian in the phase of arrival relative to the predicted burst period from history; 0 for the charger."""
    k = targets.shape[0]
    is_ch = values <= 0

    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)
    arr = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)
    d_back = np.linalg.norm(targets - charger[None, :], axis=1)
    spent = (d + d_back) * drain
    recharge = np.maximum(spent - battery, 0.0) / max(charge_rate, 1e-9)
    cyc = d + d_back + recharge + 0.2
    pay = np.where(is_ch, 0.0, arr / np.maximum(cyc, 1e-9))
    pmax = np.max(pay) if pay.size > 0 else 0.0
    pay = pay / pmax if pmax > 1e-12 else np.zeros_like(pay)

    # burst period from appearance times
    if history.shape[0] >= 4:
        app = history[:, 2]
        gaps = np.diff(app)
        gaps = gaps[gaps > 1e-6]
        if gaps.size > 0:
            P = max(float(np.median(gaps)), 2.0)
            t_last = float(app[-1])
            t_arr = time + d
            phase = np.abs(t_arr - (t_last + np.round((t_arr - t_last) / P) * P))
            w = np.exp(-0.5 * (phase / 2.0) ** 2)
        else:
            w = np.ones(k)
    else:
        w = np.ones(k)

    out = np.where(is_ch, 0.0, pay * w)
    return np.clip(out, 0.0, 1.0)

nodes.description: Score each item by current value divided by distance (or flight time) from the drone, so nearby high-value items win.

nodes.title: urgency-adjusted value
nodes.description: Score items by value minus rate times estimated travel time, so fast-decaying items are prioritised and near-dead ones ignored.

nodes.title: battery feasibility
nodes.description: Penalise or exclude items whose round-trip flight would exceed remaining battery, avoiding the 40 runout penalty.

nodes.title: charger timing
nodes.description: Score the charger by how low the battery is and how much charging time costs relative to remaining opportunity, to decide when to recharge.

nodes.title: decay horizon filter
nodes.description: Zero out items that will disappear (value/rate < travel time) before the drone can arrive, so they don't attract the drone.

nodes.title: value density with decay
nodes.description: Combine value, rate and distance into a single density: (value - rate*travel) / travel, capturing both worth and cost of the trip.

nodes.title: wide find: feasible_arrival_value
nodes.description: Battery-feasibility-adjusted arrival: net value after decay, gated by whether the flight can be made without running out.

nodes.title: wide find: survival_fraction_minus_time_share
nodes.description: Expected fraction of an item's current value that survives until arrival, minus travel-time share of remaining horizon.

nodes.title: feasible value with charger detour
nodes.description: Extend feasible_arrival_value by penalising the post-pickup trip back to the charger when the battery after pickup would be low.

nodes.title: decay-aware density
nodes.description: Value density that subtracts decay over travel time and divides by travel-plus-charging time, mining the productive density vein.

nodes.title: wide find: detour_risk_urgency
nodes.description: Opportunity cost of detour: value reachable now vs. best alternative, weighted by item lifetime vs flight time.

nodes.title: two-step lookahead value
nodes.description: Score each candidate by its own arrival value plus the best decayed value reachable after it, net of the charger trip needed to continue.

nodes.title: battery-cycle throughput
nodes.description: Rank items by value collected per full battery cycle (flight out, flight back, recharge time) so long trips are charged their true cost.

nodes.title: urgency per remaining lifetime
nodes.description: Score items by value times fraction of lifetime left relative to travel time, so items about to vanish dominate.

nodes.title: wide find: decayed_value_density
nodes.description: Density of visible decayed-value at each candidate's location: how much value sits within a competition radius (range of nearby items), decayed by travel there, so candidates in rich clusters beat is…

nodes.title: reachable value per charger cycle
nodes.description: Extend reachable_value_after_pickup by dividing the reachable decayed value by the full battery-cycle time (out, back, recharge), so dense clusters near the charger beat isolated items.

nodes.title: wide find: cluster_density_value
nodes.description: Density of decaying value around each candidate: sum of neighbours' arrival values weighted by inverse distance, so items amid clusters are preferred (charger = 0).

nodes.title: two-pickup chain value
nodes.description: Score each candidate by the best feasible two-pickup sequence (this item then a second, both decayed, battery-checked, return to charger), normalised.

nodes.title: waves burst-and-charge
nodes.description: In bursty arrival regimes, prefer items reachable within one battery cycle and time charger visits to lulls, using recent appearance rate from history.

nodes.title: wide find: neighbourhood_value_density
nodes.description: Value-weighted density of other visible items around each candidate: how much decayed value sits within a short hop of the candidate, as a proxy for a rich cluster to harvest after arriving; charger …

nodes.title: endgame no-return harvest
nodes.description: In the final stretch, ignore the charger and rank purely by arrival value per distance, since returning is worthless.

nodes.title: charger-visit opportunity cost
nodes.description: Score the charger against the best item value forfeited by charging now, scaled by remaining horizon, so charging is deferred in bursts.

nodes.title: wave-phase anticipation
nodes.description: Use recent history arrival times to estimate the current lull vs burst and bias toward charger trips during lulls.

nodes.title: value-per-time with decay-adjusted denominator
nodes.description: Extend the f012 vein: divide arrival value by travel time plus a decay-loss term, so items whose value is bleeding fast lose to items that hold value.

nodes.title: charger-aware chain timing
nodes.description: Chain value where the follow-up is discounted by the time to reach the charger after it, so chains that strand the drone far from power lose.

nodes.title: charger-cycle payoff with burst timing
nodes.description: Score items by decayed arrival value divided by the full cycle time (out, pickup, back to charger, recharge), with the cycle denominator inflated when recent arrivals suggest a burst is imminent so the drone banks battery before it.

nodes.title: post-pickup charger slack
nodes.description: Rank by arrival value gated on the battery slack left after pickup relative to the distance to the charger, so items that leave the drone stranded near the far corner are demoted.

nodes.title: three-leg chain with charger return
nodes.description: Score each candidate by the best feasible three-leg path (item, second item, back to charger) with all values decayed and battery-checked, so chains that end near the charger win.

nodes.title: burst-window cycle payoff
nodes.description: Estimate the current burst/lull phase from recent history and scale the per-cycle payoff of each item by whether its arrival falls inside a burst window.

nodes.title: burst-aware value-per-time
nodes.description: Scale f012-style value-per-time by an estimated burst/lull phase from recent arrival history, so during bursts the drone favours short high-value hops and during lulls it charges.

nodes.title: full-cycle value-per-time
nodes.description: Value-per-time where the denominator is flight time plus the amortised charger detour and recharge needed to make the pickup feasible, capturing true throughput cost.

nodes.title: wide find: local_crowd_density
nodes.description: Local crowding: for each candidate, the density of nearby still-valuable items relative to the flight time to sweep them, penalising candidates that sit in empty regions so the drone prefers targets …

nodes.title: horizon-scaled density
nodes.description: Scale value-per-time density by the share of the remaining horizon the trip consumes, so late-game trips that cannot be repaid are suppressed.

nodes.title: charger-return timing density
nodes.description: Density whose denominator includes the time to return to the charger after pickup, so items that strand the drone far from the charger lose.

nodes.title: temporal bunching sweep
nodes.description: Score items by how many other visible items expire within a short window of the same time, so the drone sweeps a temporal cluster before it decays.

nodes.title: expected next-arrival gap
nodes.description: Estimate the mean inter-arrival time from history and rank items/charger by whether acting now beats waiting for the next expected batch.

nodes.title: endgame harvest
nodes.description: In the final stretch ignore charger return and rank purely by surviving arrival value per distance, harvesting what's reachable.
